newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks rise though selling pressure looms.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks rise though selling pressure looms.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed firmer on Thursday, helped by bond gains, after a volatile afternoon session during which some selling pressure appeared.
The general index rose 2.72 points, 0.75 percent, to 367.76. The Ibex-35 leading share index gained 36.09 points, 0.86 percent, to 4,213.92.
Telefonica was unchanged at 2,400 with 3.47 million shares traded while Repsol rose 30 pesetas to 4,160.

"The bourse has maintained the rising tendency of the last few days and has a chance to continue gaining, but during the afternoon there was some more selling and we can't exclude a slight drop due to technical factors," said a portfolio manager.
Volume was heavier than the previous session at 58.7 billion pesetas, but despite the high figure traders said there was a lack of end clients.
The prospect of a correction in prices would reflect a similar movement in bonds, which continued to be the main reference for the market.

The electricity sector performed best. Endesa rose 150 pesetas, 2.03 percent, to 7,550 with 1.17 million shares traded while Iberdrola gained 1.6 percent. Among large banks, BCH poster further gains, up 2.12 percent. BBV rose 1.5 percent.
